news.title: Saint Louis University Invests Up to $1.5 Million Annually in Future Public Health Leaders
news.summary_en: The Healthier STL Scholarship is designed to prepare the next generation of public health and health management professionals committed to improving the health and well-being of communities across the St. Louis region. It's the third in a series of scholarships at SLU, investing up to $4.4 million annually in local students pursuing vital service professions.

news.title: SLU's Sarah Adam Wins Gold at WWR World Championship
news.summary_en: Sarah Adam, OTD, assistant professor of occupational science and occupational therapy at Saint Louis University, is a world champion. Adam and her teammates with USA Wheelchair Rugby earned a gold medal at the 2026 World Wheelchair Rugby World Championship in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. news.title: From Saint Louis to Kampala: Lily McMorrow Takes Cancer Research Global
news.summary_en: Lily McMorrow has earned an NIH LAUNCH Fellowship to advance cancer research at the Uganda Cancer Institute in Kampala. McMorrow, a fifth-year M.D./Ph.D. student at Saint Louis University, brings her research to an international stage, exploring the impact of international funding disruptions on cervical cancer prevention, the leading cause of cancer death among Ugandan women.
